```{r, echo = F}
celltype_list <-

celltype_list <- 
  lapply(1:length(gr_peaks_sub), function(i){
    selected_ct = c()
    for(j in names(peaks)){
      res = findOverlaps(gr_peaks_sub[i], peaks[[j]])
      if(length(res) > 0){
        if(grepl("CD4_T", j) | grepl("Treg", j)){
          j = "CD4_T"
        }else if(grepl("B", j)){
          j = "B"
        }
        selected_ct = gsub("Lung_", "", c(selected_ct, j))
      }
    }
    return(unique(selected_ct))
  })
```

## Overlap scE2G peaks with our OCRs
```{r}
# match scE2G peaks to ArchR peakset requiring at least 250 bp overlapped
getMatchedPeaks <- function(query, ref_gr){
  peak_list <- 
  lapply(query, function(i){
    p2g_gr <- GRanges(i)
    paired <- mergeByOverlaps(p2g_gr, ref_gr, minoverlap = 250)
    paired$p2g_gr <- as.character(paired$p2g_gr)
    paired$ref_gr <- as.character(paired$ref_gr)
    return(paired)
  })
  peak_tbl <- do.call(rbind, peak_list)
  return(peak_tbl)
}

out_dir <- "output/u19_multiome_doubletRM/"
multiome_p2g <- lapply(gsub("/", ".", ct_order), function(i){
  f <- fread(sprintf("%s/%s/multiome_powerlaw_v3/encode_e2g_predictions.tsv.gz",
                     out_dir, i))
  return(data.frame(f[f$E2G.Score.qnorm >= 0.2, ]))
})
multiome_p2g <- getMatchedPeaks(multiome_p2g, proj@peakSet)
```

## summarize E2G links

```{r}
summarize_scE2G <- function(p2g_links, group_by, cutoff){
  # extract links across cell types where peaks were confidently called
  gr_peaks_p2g <-
  apply(mcols(gr_peaks_sub)[, c("Peak", group_by)], 1, function(i){
    links <- 
        lapply(strsplit(i[2], ",")[[1]], function(j){
          filtered <-   
          data.frame(p2g_links[[j]]) %>% 
            dplyr::filter(ref_gr == i[1]) #& E2G.Score.qnorm >= cutoff) 
          if(nrow(filtered) != 0){
            filtered %>%
              mutate(p2g_CellType = j,
                      Peak = i[1],
                      Gene = TargetGene,
                      Beta = round(E2G.Score.qnorm, 2)) %>% 
              dplyr::select(Peak, p2g_CellType, Gene, Beta, trait) 
          }
        })
      return(do.call(rbind, links))
  })
  
  # summarize links per gene 
  p2g_summary <- do.call(rbind, gr_peaks_p2g) %>%
    filter(!(grepl("AS", Gene) | grepl("LINC", Gene)))

  barplot(
    table(
      p2g_summary[p2g_summary$Beta >= cutoff, c("Peak", "Gene")] %>% 
        distinct() %>% 
        group_by(Peak) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>% 
          pull(n)),
    main = "", xlab = "Number of links per gene across cell types"
    )
  # summarize results into a table
  p2g_tbl <-
    lapply(gr_peaks_p2g[lapply(gr_peaks_p2g, is.null) == FALSE], function(i) {
      # filter out insignificant links
      i <- i %>% filter(Beta >= cutoff)
      c(unique(i[, 1]), apply(i[, 2:4], 2, function(j) {
        paste(j, collapse = ",")
      }))
    })
  p2g_tbl <- do.call(rbind, p2g_tbl)
  colnames(p2g_tbl)[1] <- "Peak"
  p2g_tbl <- left_join(
    data.frame(Peak = gr_peaks_sub$Peak),
    data.frame(p2g_tbl), by = "Peak"
  )
  return(list(p2g_tbl, p2g_summary))
}

get_scE2G_mat <- function(p2g_summary, cutoff){
  # built a matrix of E2G scores for selected peaks 
  selected = 
    p2g_summary %>% 
      filter(Beta >= cutoff) %>%
      mutate(Label = paste(Peak, Gene, sep = "_")) %>%
      pull(Label)
  p2g_mat = 
    p2g_summary %>%
      mutate(Label = paste(Peak, Gene, sep = "_")) %>%
      filter(Label %in% unique(selected)) %>%
      dplyr::select(-c(Peak, Gene)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = p2g_CellType,
                  values_from = Beta) %>%
      na.replace(0)
  return(p2g_mat)
}
```

```{r, fig.width = 10}
# map gene id from one type to another
mapGeneIDs <- function(query, query_type,
                        output_types) {
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  mapped = AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db,
                  keys = query,
                  columns = output_types,
                  keytype = query_type)
  return(mapped)
}
```

### Blood immune eQTLs from Onek1k

```{r}
EnrichmentTestE2G <- function(eqtl_gr, multiome_gr) {
  
  # A function that tests enrichment of eQTL-gene pairs among E2G links with cell types matched and within the same genomic windows
  
  eqtl_gr <- eqtl_gr[eqtl_gr$distance <= 100000 & eqtl_gr$distance > 10000]
  multiome_gr <- multiome_gr[multiome_gr$distance <= 100000 & multiome_gr$distance > 10000]
  positive_gr <- multiome_gr[multiome_gr$E2G.Score.qnorm >= 0.4]
  positive_links <- data.frame(peak = as.character(positive_gr),
                          gene = positive_gr$TargetGene)
  # matching SNP-gene pairs
  overlaps <-
    findOverlaps(eqtl_gr, multiome_gr+250) 
  overlapped_links <- data.frame(
    peak = as.character(multiome_gr[overlaps@to]),
    gene = as.character(eqtl_gr$targetGene[overlaps@from]))
  
  out <-
    EnrichmentTest(unique(paste(positive_links$peak, positive_links$gene, sep = ":")),
                 unique(paste(overlapped_links$peak, overlapped_links$gene, sep = ":")),
                 unique(paste(as.character(multiome_gr), multiome_gr$TargetGene, sep = ":")))
  return(out)
}


```

```{r}
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
library(VariantAnnotation)

txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene
genes_gr <- genes(txdb)

# Load your full variant set once (not per gene — too slow otherwise)
variants <- fread("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/other_data/scE2G/QTD000625.all.tsv.gz")
# retain only common variants
variants <- variants[variants$maf >= 0.05, ] %>% 
  dplyr::select(chromosome, position, variant, maf, rsid) %>%
  distinct()
all_variants <- GRanges(seqnames = paste0("chr", variants$chromosome),
                        ranges = as.character(variants$position))
mcols(all_variants) <- variants
rm(variants)

```

```{r}
ref <- fread("data/scE2G/tabix_ftp_paths.tsv")
ftp_path <- 
  ref %>% filter(study_label == "OneK1K" & quant_method == "ge") %>%
    filter(sample_group %in% c("B_memory", "B_naive", "CD4_Naive", 
                               "CD4_TCM", "CD4_TEM", "CD8_Naive",
                               "CD8_TCM", "CD8_TEM", "NK", "NK_Proliferating", "Treg")) 

eqtl_list <- 
  lapply(c("B_memory", "B_naive", "CD4", "CD8", "NK", "Treg"), function(i) {
    idx = grep(i, ftp_path$sample_group)
    print(idx)
    eqtl <- c()
    for(i in idx){
      f <- fread(paste0("data/scE2G/",
                        basename(ftp_path$ftp_cs_path[i])))
      eqtl <- rbind(eqtl, f[f$pip >= 0.3, ])}
      eqtl <- eqtl[eqtl$variant %in% all_variants$variant] #keep common variants
      # make a GRange object
      eqtl$position <-
        unlist(lapply(eqtl$variant, function(i) {
          paste(strsplit(i, "_")[[1]][1:2], collapse = ":")
        }))
      eqtl_gr <- GRanges(eqtl$position)
      mcols(eqtl_gr) <- eqtl
      # convert to gene symbols
      mapped_genes <- mapGeneIDs(
        query = eqtl_gr$gene_id,
        query_type = "ENSEMBL",
        output_types = "SYMBOL"
      )
      eqtl_gr$targetGene <-
        mapped_genes$SYMBOL[match(eqtl_gr$gene_id, mapped_genes$ENSEMBL)]
      eqtl_gr <-
        eqtl_gr[!is.na(eqtl_gr$targetGene) &
                  eqtl_gr$targetGene %in% proj@geneAnnotation$genes$symbol]
      # compute the distance of variants to gene body
      eqtl_gr$distance <-
        unlist(lapply(seq_along(eqtl_gr), function(i) {
          gene = proj@geneAnnotation$genes[which(proj@geneAnnotation$genes$symbol == eqtl_gr$targetGene[i])]
          return(distance(eqtl_gr[i], gene))
        }))
    return(eqtl_gr) 
  })
names(eqtl_list) <- c("B_memory", "B_naive", "CD4", "CD8", "NK", "Treg")
```

```{r, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 5}
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", limits = c(0, 1))  + 
  scale_size_continuous() +
  geom_point() + 
  xlab("") + ylab("") + 
  theme_pub() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, vjust = 0.55)) + 
       # panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eeeeee", colour = "grey10")) +
  labs(color = "scE2G score",
         size = "Peak Accessibility") #bulk

```

```{r}
# A summary table for the final list of CRE and target genes
highlighted <- p2g_summary %>% 
  filter(E2G.Score.qnorm >= 0.2) %>%
  mutate(E2G.Score.qnorm = round(E2G.Score.qnorm, 2))
final_tbl <-
  lapply(split(highlighted, highlighted$Label), function(i) {
    apply(i[, c("E2G.Score.qnorm", "CellType")], 2, function(j){paste(j, collapse = ",")})
  })
final_tbl <- data.frame(
  pair = names(final_tbl),
  do.call(rbind, final_tbl),
  row.names = NULL)
                        
write.table(final_tbl, "output/asthma_CRE_p2g_links_final_list.txt", quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")
```
